note: World data packs, applied once per save at server start. See docs/TOA_DATA_PACKS.md.

packs.name: 010-toa-ml-spells
packs.description: Master Level spells and their eight spell lines (gaheris 12, 42, 43): 73 of 80 ranks.

packs.name: 011-toa-ml-paths
packs.description: The eight Master Level paths in every class career at level 50 (gaheris 39). They stay hidden until the Arbiter grants Master Levels.

packs.name: 012-toa-artifact-spells
packs.description: Artifact spells from gaheris 90, filtered: the 68 spell IDs our artifact items reference and lack, plus the 5 spells they chain to. 5 referenced IDs exist nowhere.

packs.name: 020-atlantis-mobs
packs.description: Atlantis population from db-public via gaheris 13: 41,727 mobs tagged PackageID 'gaheris-atlantis' (overworld, Haven cities, Aerus, pyramid entrance).

packs.name: 021-atlantis-travel
packs.description: Atlantis teleport destinations (gaheris 14): 13 rows of type gaheris.

packs.name: 022-atlantis-zonepoints
packs.description: Atlantis zone points (gaheris 29): 100 rows, existing ones kept.

packs.name: 023-artifact-scroll-binders
packs.description: Artifact scroll binder merchants (gaheris 36): 162 merchant rows, scroll prices, Zosyne and Mnosus.

packs.name: 024-toa-arbiter-npcs
packs.description: The Master Level NPCs of gaheris 35: the three Arbiters become DOL.GS.MasterLevelArbiter, Demyphon in region 72 a Master Level credit merchant.

packs.name: 025-toa-atlantis-arena-fix
packs.description: Removes the three Atlas fight-club Mordreds (DOL.GS.LordOfBattle) from Albion Atlantis, regions 73 and 80; the ones in 334 and 339 stay.

packs.name: 026-toa-travel-realms
packs.description: Atlantis travel per realm: 33 Teleport rows of type atlantis (ruins city, four havens, six dungeon entrances in each realm copy), ten haven porters, and the Oceanus channelers that were plain NPCs become porters.

packs.name: 027-toa-open-atlantis
packs.description: Opens Atlantis to players (atlantis_teleport_plvl 4 or 2 -> 1) and sets rog_toa_item_chance 0 -> 25, the ToA bonus chance of random loot inside Atlantis.

packs.name: 030-toa-dungeon-mobs

packs.name: 031-toa-dungeon-templates

packs.name: 040-toa-loot

packs.name: 041-toa-loot-caps
